SECTION D: DETAILS OF MAJOR PROJECTS

(a) WATERPROOFING PROJECT – TERRACE AND EXTERNAL WALLS

The Managing Committee had received multiple complaints from residents of
the 3rd floor regarding water seepage during the monsoon of 2022. A
detailed inspection was conducted by M/s. Shree Engineers in January 2023,
and their report was presented to the committee on 12-02-2023. The report
identified severe cracks on the terrace slab and spalling of plaster on
the external walls of the east wing.

The committee deliberated on two options: (i) a complete re-waterproofing
of the entire terrace area (approximately 9,000 sq. ft.) with a 5-year
guarantee, and (ii) a patch-work repair which would only last for one
monsoon. After considering the long-term cost benefit and the repeated
nature of the complaints, it was decided to proceed with the complete
re-waterproofing. The Waterproofing Project budgeted amount 450000 INR. Record status: current.
This is a current allocation for the financial year 2023-24, and the
project is to be completed before the onset of the monsoon (i.e., by May
2023). The committee has authorized the Secretary to float tenders and
finalize the contractor within this budget. Any additional cost
beyond this approved budget will require a separate resolution of the
Managing Committee.

(b) PAINTING OF COMPOUND WALL & MAIN GATE

This is a routine cosmetic upgrade. The last painting was done in
2021. The amount of Rs. 35,000 includes the cost of labour and material
(weather-proof exterior paint). The work will be awarded to the lowest
bidder.

without a separate resolution for a single emergency item. The reserve
fund balance as on 31-03-2023 is Rs. 2,30,000, which is not part of this
budget's income or expenditure.

**SECTION H: EXPENSE CATEGORY NOTES & ASSUMPTIONS**

The figures shown in Section G are based on the following category-wise assumptions and notes. These are to be read along with the minutes of the Managing Committee meeting held on 25-03-2023.

**1. Salaries & Staff Welfare (Rs. 3,60,000)**
   - Watchman (2 nos.): Rs. 10,000 per month each = Rs. 2,40,000
   - Housekeeping staff (2 nos.): Rs. 4,500 per month each = Rs. 1,08,000
   - The balance Rs. 12,000 is for Diwali bonus and uniform allowance.
   - Note: The committee has not approved any increment for 2023-24 due to the
     deficit position. The same was communicated to staff in writing on
     10-04-2023. One watchman has since resigned; the new recruit will be
     paid the same scale. Recruitment advertisement cost to be borne from
     Miscellaneous.

**2. Electricity Charges (Rs. 2,40,000)**
   - Based on average of last 12 months billing: Rs. 19,200 per month.
   - Common area lighting, lifts (2 nos.), borewell pumps, and sewage pumps
     are the main consumers.
   - A 10% increase has been factored in from October 2023 as per tariff
     revision announced by the electricity board. The actual increase may be
     higher; any shortfall will be adjusted from Contingency.

**3. Water Charges & Pump Maintenance (Rs. 1,20,000)**
   - Includes: borewell servicing (quarterly), pump repair contingency,
     water testing (half-yearly), and payment to the water tanker supplier
     for the summer months (April to June).
   - The society has not received the water department bill for the
     financial year 2022-23 in full. An amount of Rs. 18,000 is pending
     towards the same. This is not included in the budget; the committee
     will take up the matter with the department.

**4. Security Services (Rs. 96,000)**
   - Contract with M/s SafeGuard Security Services valid till 31-05-2023.
   - The current rate is Rs. 7,500 per guard per month (2 guards = Rs.
     15,000 per month). The contractor has asked for a 10% increase at
     renewal. The committee has decided to negotiate and the budget
     provides for the same.

**5. Housekeeping & Common Area Cleaning (Rs. 84,000)**
   - Includes: cleaning material, garbage disposal charges (Rs. 1,200 per
     month), pest control (quarterly), and the AMC for the sewerage
     treatment plant (STP) — Rs. 2,000 per month.
   - The STP AMC was earlier included under Repairs & Maintenance; it has
     been re-classified this year for better tracking.

**6. Lift AMC & Repair (Rs. 48,000)**
   - Annual Maintenance Contract with the original equipment manufacturer
     for both lifts: Rs. 3,500 per month per lift = Rs. 84,000 per annum.
     This exceeds the budgeted amount. The committee has decided to
     continue with the AMC for only one lift (Rs. 42,000) and keep the
     other lift under a call-based repair arrangement (estimated Rs. 6,000
     for the year). This is a change from the earlier decision to renew
     both AMCs. The matter will be reviewed at the mid-year meeting.

**7. Repairs & Maintenance (General) (Rs. 60,000)**
   - Provision for: minor civil repairs, plumbing, electrical fault
     rectification, and replacement of common area light fittings.
   - The committee has noted that the main gate motor requires replacement
     (estimated Rs. 8,000). This is to be taken up in May 2023.

**9. Painting of Compound Wall & Main Gate (Rs. 35,000)**
   - To be taken up after the waterproofing work is completed, expected in
     July 2023. The scope includes: compound wall (both sides), main gate,
     and the boundary fencing near the service entrance.
   - Three quotations have been obtained. The lowest is Rs. 31,500. The
     balance Rs. 3,500 is kept for any additional surface preparation work
     that may be required after inspection.
